payload.body: CORRECTION: commit 2a679d5 (previously credited) implemented NOTHING — its only server.ts change was a doc comment, so main was RED. The cursor API was actually implemented in cbbeb72 (GET /streams/:type/:id/cursor -> {headSequence,count} via StreamStore.head/FrickStore.streamHead; ?since=<seq> forward reads via StreamStore.read; 400 stream.invalidCursor regenerated into core/swift/kotlin). Pushed to origin/main @ 6441587. Full suite green (1012 passed).
